title: Server and Windows client, ready for localhost.
summary: Download the complete package to explore Rookgaard and test your own changes in a separate local world.
changes: Server, test database and Windows .exe client in one package.
START-LOCAL.cmd prepares the world; STOP-LOCAL.cmd preserves its progress.
Normal demo account: 1 / local123, character Local Adventurer.
paragraphs: Requires Docker Desktop with Linux containers and internet for the first setup. The Windows client is already included.
Build, login, map entry, client movement and saved position after restart were validated. This is a test release; not every quest or game system has been fully tested.

title: Tibia 7.4 — A classic rpg version.
summary: Previously Antigas, the project now shares its code, development story and credits with the community on GitHub.
changes: New project name and public source repository.
README with the story behind the server and paths for players and contributors.
Original copyright notices and third-party licenses preserved.
paragraphs: The server was born from a dream of sharing adventures, exploration and good memories with the community. The project continues to evolve with its players and contributors.

This is an independent project with custom systems, inspired by Tibia. Credits include Alejandro Mujica, the OpenTibia and OTClient communities, and rxi. Tibia was created by CipSoft; this project is not affiliated with it.
